SELECT COALESCE(b.infra_reason,'unspecified') AS "Reason",count(*) AS "Builds"
FROM build b JOIN repository r ON r.id=b.repository_id
WHERE r.name='nibinrj/buildlens-lab' AND b.infra_failure AND b.started_at BETWEEN '2026-09-19T08:35:47.31Z' AND '2026-10-19T08:35:47.31Z'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC,1;
